# Security policy

Please don't report vulnerabilities in public issues. Use
[GitHub's private advisory form](https://github.com/sysmrk/Adhd-Duck/security/advisories/new)
with the affected version, what an attacker needs, and how to reproduce it.

Fixes go into the latest release. See [docs/security.md](../docs/security.md)
for ADHD Duck's trust boundaries and a hardening checklist.
